post.description:
Finalize first-login onboarding: set bot name + mark as onboarded.

Idempotent — calling after onboarding still updates the name if unchanged,
but won't reset onboarded_at or convert the durable execution mode. The
hosted/byo choice becomes server-authoritative on first completion.

Handles the TOCTOU race where two concurrent requests pick the same name:
the DB unique constraint on `agents.name` raises IntegrityError on commit
and we translate it into a 409 without crashing.
Explicitly transfer public runtime ownership without replacing the Agent.
